chart.name: Cache hit ratio (%)

noDataOptions.noDataMessage: Currently, no data is available for this chart.

chart.programText:
A = data('mongodb.cache.operations', filter=filter('type', 'hit')).sum(by=['host.name']).publish(label='A', enable=False)
B = data('mongodb.cache.operations', filter=filter('type', 'miss')).sum(by=['host.name']).publish(label='B', enable=False)
C = ((A+1)/(A+B+1)).scale(100).publish(label='C')
